scope: 2024–2026 activity/function/task-conditioned indoor generation: 8 main/adjacent papers plus parent-requested SetItUp conference/journal lineage; primary-evidence read-only review.
target: Activity/function/task requirements -> room layout and assets -> independent physical usability and robot evidence. Original FastFill exact textual furniture inventory/unknownsizes is a separate input regime that must be preserved in fair comparisons.

entries.name: Nav2Scene
entries.title: Nav2Scene: Navigation-driven fine-tuning for robot-friendly scene generation
entries.reading_tier: Publisher primary abstract + author publication listing; full text request returned403. Detailed metric/algorithm implementation unverified.
entries.actual_input: Existing scene generator conditions are retained; navigation suitability is a training objective. No evidence of a user-supplied free-form activity/task specification as native input in accessible text.
entries.method: Compute Path Planning Score(PPS) from path-planning results, learn a ScoreNet predictor, and use predicted PPS to fine-tune existing scene generators.

evaluation.confirmed: 3D-FRONT generation/completion/re-arrangement; PPS/navigation compatibility and scene quality/diversity studied.
evaluation.unverified: Exact planner/PPS definition, scene splits, quality metric list, baseline configs unavailable from accessible primary abstract.
evaluation.robot_rollout: Not established. PPS from a path planner is geometric planning evidence, not an embodied policy success/SPL rollout.

code.scope: Publisher and author pages plus targeted title/GitHub searches did not establish an official repo; publisher says data available on request.
code.not_claimed: No claim no code exists anywhere.

entries.relation_to_fastfill: Direct prior for learning/guiding layout generation with navigation utility. Need exact furniture-ID/size/source conditions, agent footprint and matched planner settings; no claim of direct unknown-size inventory compatibility.
innovation_excluded: Navigation quality as a training/fine-tuning signal
Learned differentiable surrogate of geometry/planning utility
entries.safe_takeaway: Test planner solvability and independent fixed-policy rollouts separately; avoid reporting predicted ScoreNet utility as actual task success.

entries.name: Steerable Scene Generation
entries.title: Steerable Scene Generation with Post Training and Inference-Time Search
entries.actual_input: Fixed known asset library with asset IDs and full SE(3) poses; text/structured inpainting can specify object counts/types; task reward steers clutter or feasibility.
entries.method: Procedural-data diffusion prior + conditional generation, RL post-training or MCTS inference-time search; nonlinear projection and simulation postprocess.

evaluation.robot_rollout: Paper§3.4/project report Drake mobile KUKAiiwa teleoperated pick/place in a subset of scenes, qualitative simulation-readiness validation. No quantitative autonomous task success or policy learning benefit established here.
evaluation.manipulation: Actual teleoperation demonstration, not only loadability; limited evidence tier.

files.observed: Metric/generation driver; selected source read, not run.
Count/category prompt evaluation, not arbitrary activity verification.

implementation_caveats: Unparseable prompts get1in per-prompt arrays while aggregate excludes them; record identifiable denominator before reusing arbitrary functional prompts.
Signed-distance exception returns zero penetration at scene_metrics.py:64; require explicit failures when adapting.
entries.relation_to_fastfill: Useful task-steering prior but input already supplies real fixed-size asset geometry. Not the same unknown-size text inventory condition; candidate search/physics cost must be included.
innovation_excluded: Reward-steered diffusion scene generation
RL post-training or MCTS to optimize scene task objectives
SE(3)physically feasible asset composition
entries.safe_takeaway: Separate qualitative robot demo from a fixed-robot quantitative task benchmark.

entries.name: Function2Scene
entries.title: Function2Scene: 3D Indoor Scene Layout from Functional Specifications
entries.date_venue: First arXiv2026-05-29; no conference venue asserted
entries.actual_input: Natural-language design brief specifying occupant personas and activities; initializes room structure for user verification, reformulates scene content, and refines object layouts/sizes.
entries.method: Parse17functional design criteria across spatial/ergonomic/activity/environmental categories;29geometry/LLM/VLM tools; six priority tiers with sequential check/repair.

evaluation.confirmed: 30professionally written cases,10room types;30-person2AFC comparing functional and parsed prompts; reported94.3%aggregate preference. Grounded tool ablations.
evaluation.scope: Rendered-layout human preference and mixed geometric/contextual checks. Human participants judged layouts; they did not physically execute room activities in this study.
evaluation.robot_rollout: None established. pathfinding/reach/posture tools are not robot task rollouts.

code.scope: Author project exposes Paper/Viewer, no official implementation/evaluator repository link located. Matching-name GitHub account has no public repos in web listing, but account ownership was not used as official proof.
code.not_claimed: No claim no code exists anywhere.

entries.relation_to_fastfill: Direct function/task-to-room prior. It can infer/add furniture and resize; enforce exact supplied IDs and immutable observed shell for original FastFill main task. Independent task verification needed beyond self-selected tools.
innovation_excluded: Persona/activity→custom constraint taxonomy
Grounded tool-assisted function-aware layout check/repair
Function-zone/workflow/circulation requirements as generation input
entries.safe_takeaway: Adding function groups and another critic is insufficient novelty; evaluate actual task execution separately.

entries.name: FuncRoom-Agent
entries.title: FuncRoom-Agent: Sequential Feed-Forward 3D Functional Indoor Scene Generation
entries.version_note: Audit uses v2; do not mix with mirroredv1 results.
entries.actual_input: Functional intent plus optional reference image; prompt specifies intended activities, required objects and appearance preferences. It generates room structure, major furniture and nested small objects as executable DSL stages.
entries.method: Recursive DSL + visual-context SFT distilled from verified multimodal construction traces + execution-grounded ScenePRM/GRPO; sequential feed-forward test-time controller without online repair/search.

evaluation.benchmarks: 30SceneEval room prompts plus50Function-Room prompts excluded from training.
metrics: Functional Object Coverage(FOC), allowing frozen alternatives
Functional Object Precision(FOP), penalizing irrelevant/excessive objects
evaluation.verification: LLM-proposed functional annotations are manually corrected and frozen; finalVLM evaluation uses GPT5.5, separate from training-timeGPT5.2ScenePRM. This separates judge identity but does not establish physical activity execution.
evaluation.robot_rollout: Not established; no robot task success metric reported in inspected experimental sections.
evaluation.speed_boundary: Paper reports25min scene generation and comparisons, not a millisecond pose-only model; includes asset generation/execution pipeline.

code.scope: No official project/repo link found in arXiv metadata/body or targeted exact-title search. Paper appendix contains DSL/executor/evaluator descriptions; that is not an executable code release.
code.not_claimed: No claim no code exists anywhere.

entries.relation_to_fastfill: Very close prior to distilling expensive activity-aware generation into a specialist with process rewards and noonline repair. Unknown-size exact-ID boundary still needs adaptation and implementation access.
innovation_excluded: Function-room generation benchmark
Distill recursive scene-building traces into a compact sequential controller
Execution-grounded process reward and RL for scene construction
Moving repeated online checking into training
entries.safe_takeaway: A lightweight task-aware FastFill claim must compare real latency/compute and independent executable-task success, not just controller size.

entries.name: FuncScene
entries.title: FuncScene: Function-centric Indoor Scene Synthesis via a Variational AutoEncoder Framework
entries.actual_input: Native room boundary; predicts/selects functional group types and layouts, then retrieves group instances. Function groups are a scene prior/control level, not an open-ended user activity interpreter.
entries.method: Functional-group VAE hierarchy: category/number prediction -> group generation -> group instantiation from3D-FRONT/FUTURE.

evaluation.FI_definition: Living-room presence of Dining/Reception/Entertainment groups; group present if its primary objects and at least one secondary-primary object exist, normalized0–1. Measures inventory composition, not physical usability.
evaluation.human: 20trained university participants judging plausibility/functionality; no physical execution.

code.provenance: Repository README self-identifies as accompanying paper code; author page confirms paper but direct repository linkage not independently established.

files.observed: README describes main.py/train/test, but complete current tree contains onlyREADME and teaser.png; noPython implementation.

entries.relation_to_fastfill: Functional zoning/group synthesis predates our work; fixed required furniture and unknown sizes need explicit adapter. FI can be gamed by adding group objects; not use as sole task success.
innovation_excluded: Coarse-to-fine functional-group layout generation
entries.safe_takeaway: Do not report it as runnable open-source baseline merely becauseREADME says code accompanies paper.

entries.name: Behavior-Aware Anthropometric Scene Generation
entries.title: Behavior-Aware Anthropometric Scene Generation for Human-Usable 3D Layouts
entries.actual_input: Scene instructions and real assets plus behavior/person-specific anthropometry; infers group/interaction relations and operational clearance. Real asset dimensions are known.
entries.method: VLM semantic/behavior analysis -> human movement/reach clearance constraints -> LayoutVLM-style groupwise differentiable optimization.

evaluation.actual_human_execution: Office/lounge with matched furniture sets and5.5×5.5×2.5m plan;20individual participants and18group participants physically perform tasks in recreated layouts, motion capture. Measures task completion time, trajectory count, action sequence labels and operational-volume usage.
evaluation.robot_rollout: None; actual human task execution is stronger than render-only usability but is not robot performance.
evaluation.limits: Small environments/population; mainly horizontal arrangements, no general vertical parametric asset optimization.

code.scope: Author project and article provide paper/video/appendix, no verified official generator/evaluator GitHub located. Do not substitute the separateHumanOperationalScene repository as full code for thisCHI paper.
code.not_claimed: No claim no code exists anywhere.

entries.relation_to_fastfill: Important independent evaluation model for user/robot-specific clearance. Known asset geometry and per-user body profile exceed original unknown-size inventory input.
innovation_excluded: Activity/anthropometry-derived interaction volumes
Task-oriented clearance beyond walkable passage
Function-group optimization with actual human-use assessment
entries.safe_takeaway: Distinguish body envelope/geometry checks from empirical user execution and from robot rollout.

entries.name: Human-OperationalScene
entries.title: Human-operational 3D indoor layout generation with LLM-driven anthropometric simulation
entries.actual_input: Scene topology/description and anthropometric settings; LLM predicts plausible object-linked atomic human actions, then derives spatial rules. Activities may be inferred from scene, not necessarily explicit external task instruction.
entries.method: Action predictor -> rule generator for clearance/access/alignment -> rules as scene-graph diffusion edge attributes during train/inference.

evaluation.confirmed: 3D-FRONT comparison against InstructScene; rule-violation/usability and coherence claims.
evaluation.limits: This audit uses publisher abstract/project and code description; complete generator evaluation/metric implementation not reviewed.
evaluation.robot_rollout: Not established. Anthropometric simulation/rule compliance is not an embodied rollout.

code.provenance: Author project Dataset link resolves to repository.

entries.relation_to_fastfill: Reusable source of explicit action-conditioned clearance rules; do not feedGTscene topology/relations to FastFill when baseline onlygets empty shell/inventory.
innovation_excluded: LLM-generated anthropometric spatial rules as scene generator conditions
entries.safe_takeaway: Open action/rule preprocessing does not establish released trained layout generator or full paper evaluator.

entries.name: AccioScene (formerly Functional3DSceneSynthesis)
entries.title: AccioScene: Compositional 3D Scene Generation via Graph Diffusion and Interaction-driven Critics
entries.version_note: v1 titleFunctional3DSceneSynthesis throughHuman-SceneOptimization;v2 renamedAccioScene and adds author. Count as onework lineage.
entries.actual_input: Partial text content -> graph diffusion -> layout; human interaction priors and critics enforce coherence. Not a native complete activity-program/robot-task specification.
entries.method: Scene graph generation + semantic/spatial critics + lightweight human-object priors for arrangement refinement.

evaluation.boundary: Human body/interaction plausibility and collision reduction, no actual human action completion or robot task success established in inspectedv2experiment.

code.scope: Current arXivbody/author lab listing and exact-title searches did not establish an official code repository.
code.not_claimed: No claim no code exists anywhere.

entries.relation_to_fastfill: Prior for human-aware functional refinement; generated extra objects are allowed in original partial-text protocol, unlike exact required-ID inventory.
innovation_excluded: Semantic+spatial critics and interaction priors refining scene graphs/layouts
entries.safe_takeaway: Human-aware scene synthesis should not be relabeled as robot-manipulation validated.

entries.name: SetItUp (RSS2024 / IJRR2025 lineage)
entries.title: “Set It Up!”: Functional Object Arrangement with Compositional Generative Models

date_venue.journal_extension: IJRR2025; separate arXiv first submitted 2025-08-04; publisher online date 2025-11-01

entries.reading_tier: Primary full arXiv HTML for each version and author project; source code not established.
entries.actual_input: Under-specified functional instruction plus a given set of object categories and known 2D shapes/bounding boxes. RSS2024 also uses a few training examples and human-defined task-family program sketch. Journal version uses structured natural-language task specifications and compositional program induction.
entries.method: LLM induces abstract spatial relations / grounding graph, then composes spatial-relation diffusion models to generate planar object poses. Functional activity requirements are a native generation input, rather than solely a post-hoc VLM score.

version_scope.RSS2024: Study desks, dining tables, coffee tables; tabletop 2D arrangement. Bedroom/bookshelf results must not be attributed to this conference paper.
version_scope.IJRR2025: Dining tables, bookshelves, bedroom layouts; expanded specification/program induction and robot reachability relations.

evaluation.RSS2024_metrics: Physical feasibility is proportion of collision-free objects via 2D collision detection. Basic functionality is manually defined functional-relation satisfaction, including reach from predetermined user positions, unobstructed access, intended use and handedness. Twenty graduate students each rate 30 scenes from 1 to 5 for functional/convenience/aesthetic criteria. PyBullet renders the resulting poses; 3D object models are not used to infer poses.
evaluation.IJRR2025_metrics: 2D collision-free and container-bound feasibility; manually specified functional-relation satisfaction; human functionality and aesthetics ratings. Bedroom container is the room; window/door obstruction can enter manual functional rules. These are not autonomous robot-policy success rates.
evaluation.RSS2024_robot_execution: Appendix A-G reports real Franka Emika Panda + parallel gripper + RealSense D435 tabletop execution. Vision derives 2D object shapes with some human category labeling; direct placement-order search, scripted top-down grasp/reach/place and a motion planner execute layouts. No aggregate autonomous task success rate established in reviewed text.
evaluation.IJRR2025_robot_execution: Sections 6.6–6.7 introduce robot reachability predicates at 50/60/70 cm radii and report two Franka Research 3 arms arranging a six-diner buffet with more than 30 objects. Initial poses/types are known; standard scripted motion planning uses predefined grasp/approach sequences. This is actual robot demonstration, not merely geometric reachability. Aggregate autonomous task success / policy-transfer gains were not established here.
evaluation.robot_limit: Paper explicitly targets goal-level arrangement specifications; trajectory generation and online replanning belong to the downstream execution stack.

code.scope: Author project has a Code label with empty href in the checked HTML. The non-empty GitHub link is Nerfies website-template source, not SetItUp model code. Primary-paper appendix prompts are available; executable model/evaluator release was not established by inspected official surfaces and targeted title searches.
code.not_claimed: No claim that no code exists anywhere.

entries.relation_to_fastfill: Direct prior for under-specified functional instructions plus a fixed object inventory producing relational constraints and poses. Known object shapes/2D geometry differ from unknown-size inventory completion, and RSS2024 tabletop input differs from room-shell input. IJRR2025 bedroom task is closer but still requires matched geometry and condition adapters.
innovation_excluded: Task instruction to object relations to object poses
Few-shot/program-sketch induction of functional arrangement rules
Compositional spatial-relation diffusion
Adding robot reachability as a relation constraint
entries.safe_takeaway: Use this as functional-layout and goal-generation precedent. Keep conference versus journal scope separate, distinguish 2D relation metrics from robot execution, and report robot demonstrations separately from aggregate autonomous success.
